question: C lies on the mid-point of the horizontal line joining A and B, such that B is to the east of C. D is to the north-east of C. E is to the south of A. F is to the north-west of E and south-west of A. What is the position of D with respect to F?
solution:
From the given information:

Step 1: C lies on the mid-point of the horizontal line joining A and B, such that B is to the East of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28b8807d6d2a388fe40bd3794792790670d911c3f0d28504bbfd415e0f38ffbc.png] 

Step 2: D is to the North-East of C. E is to the South of A.
